status: INVALID: real-video parity failed. In-process observer is disabled; do not use its masks or make conclusions from this experiment.
purpose: Measure local effects of conditioning versus other spatial memory content on fixed sampled frames without changing Lean video propagation.
frames: For each video, use the first propagated frame after the fixed automatic prompt, plus four evenly spaced indices from prompt to final frame, rounded and deduplicated; no ground-truth-dependent sampling. Sequence 3 is an engineering replay only.
method: Replay the exact indexed-position Lean reference. At each sampled read, after obtaining the original author memory-attention output, separately rerun the same author memory attention and SAM mask decoder with (a) all memory unchanged as an exact no-op, (b) conditioning spatial memory content set to zero while retaining its positional encoding and token count, and (c) nonconditioning spatial memory content set to zero while retaining positions and token count. Pointer-tail tokens are unchanged. Save these shadow masks and return the original unmodified attention and decoder outputs to video propagation. Remove shadow-only observer events from the diagnostic trace, then require all actual masks, nonconditioning selections, indexed position receipts and model weights to match the archived reference.
validation: Two independently executed label-free seq3 shadow replays must reproduce identical masks and traces and exactly match the reference video. The unchanged-memory shadow must reproduce the author attention output, usage, decoder output and saved video mask. Verify conditioning position vectors, fixed segment bounds, pointer preservation, zeroed segments, image sizes, and restored hooks. These are engineering checks, not efficacy criteria.
analysis: After each exact replay completes, score each saved shadow mask and reference mask against the same labels on the predetermined sampled frames. Report present-frame Dice differences, labeled-empty predictions and fraction of changed image pixels; do not select frames or interventions by label and do not feed shadow outputs back into memory. This is a one-step intervention conditional on the same reference state, not a full-video strategy or evidence of generalization.
constraints: No new re-detection, inference threshold, confidence gate or actual propagation change. Zeroed-memory shadows are diagnostic ablations, not a proposed inference gate. Reference features and labels may be wrong or incomplete.
